business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides property management services and value-added services in Mainland China, including commercial property management and residential property management.

segments.name: Property management services
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, note 5 revenue table, text lines around 8270

segments.name: Value-added services
segments.source: Annual Report 2025, note 5 revenue table, text lines around 8270

business_overview.revenue_model: Contract revenue from property management and value-added services, plus small variable rental income from investment property operating leases.
business_notes: Revenue is derived solely from Mainland China operations.
As at 31 December 2025, the group managed 14 commercial properties and had 36.0 million sq.m. GFA under management.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Income on cash deposits and related-party loan; excluded from operating cash profit when related principal is counted as detachable funds.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated cash flow adjustments and note 31(b)
Annual Report 2025, cash flow adjustments and note 27

funds_assets.item: Cash and bank balances excluding time deposits
funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks; mostly Mainland China RMB deposits, with HKD and USD balances also disclosed.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 21 and MD&A liquidity section

funds_assets.business_substance: Non-pledged time deposits with original maturity over three months; terms vary from six months to three years.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, note 21 and cash flow cash-equivalent reconciliation

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from property management and value-added services, net of ECL.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position and note 19

operating_assets.business_substance: Operating prepayments, deposits and other receivables.
Owned office equipment and right-of-use assets for office properties.

investment_assets.item: Amount due from China SCE Group, non-trade related
investment_assets.business_substance: Secured related-party loan, fixed interest 5.5%, repayable within twelve months, net of RMB3.007 million impairment allowance.
Commercial-use properties; treated as operating/investment property, not cash-like for owner earnback.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position
Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position

other_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position

financing_liabilities.business_substance: No borrowings and no assets pledged for borrowings at 31 December 2025.
financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, MD&A Borrowings and Pledge of Assets

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Office property lease liabilities; treated as ordinary operating lease burden rather than cash debt deduction in owner earnback.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables, normally settled in 30 to 120 days.

operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Customer/contract obligations requiring future service delivery.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position

other_liabilities.item: Tax payable and deferred tax liabilities
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 and 2024 operating cash flow exceeded reported parent profit, but cash flow includes large interest received from cash and related-party loan. Core operating profit after excluding interest is much lower than reported operating cash flow.

evidence.value: No borrowings; no assets restricted or pledged for borrowings
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, MD&A Liquidity, Financial and Capital Resources
Annual Report 2025, note 31(a), non-trade amount due from China SCE Group

evidence.value: HKD 555.2 million unused for strategic acquisitions and investments by 31 December 2027
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, Use of Net Proceeds table
Annual Report 2025 and Annual Report 2024 consolidated cash flow statements

gaps: Annual report does not split cash by legal entity, parent company, subsidiary and bank account restriction beyond the statement that no assets are pledged for borrowings.
Unused IPO proceeds are disclosed in HKD; owner earnback analysis converts HKD 555.2 million to RMB using 2025-12-31 HKD/CNY reference rate 0.9057.
Related-party loan collateral details and post-year-end repayment status were not verified beyond the annual report.
